exposure: untreated abnormal cervical cytology vs. abnormal cervical cytology after treatment
low-grade abnormal cervical cytology vs. high-grade abnormal cervical cytology
cohort: This study included 71,097 Chinese women with live singleton births.
finding: Pregnant women with cervical disorders, especially high-grade abnormal cervical cytology and abnormal cervical cytology after treatment, were more likely to experience premature delivery, PPROM, LBW, and VLBW.
birth_weight: Women with cervical disorders had a higher risk of low birth weight (LBW) and very low birth weight (VLBW)
